title: Zoos & Wildlife
heading: A day for the animal-mad
intro: Somebody will have a favourite before you even get through the gate. UK zoos and wildlife parks make a day of watching, wondering and spotting something you have never seen up close. Browse the guides and see which place gets your group talking. Give yourselves time to explore, check the day's talks or activities with the venue and work a food break into the plan. The best bits are often the ones you stop and watch for a little longer.
